mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, discount_amount, freight_amount, pay_amount, status, pay_type, pay_time, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail, remark, expire_time, cancel_type, cancel_reason, finish_time, version, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{payTime}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverProvince}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverDistrict}, #{receiverDetail}, #{remark}, #{expireTime}, #{cancelType}, #{cancelReason}, #{finishTime}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, discount_amount, freight_amount, pay_amount, status, pay_type, pay_time, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail, remark, expire_time, cancel_type, cancel_reason, finish_time, version, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM order_info WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, discount_amount, freight_amount, pay_amount, status, pay_type, pay_time, receiver_name, expire_time, create_time, update_time FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET status = 5, cancel_type = 5, cancel_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE order_info SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE order_info SET status = 4, cancel_type = 1, cancel_reason = '用户取消', update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE order_info SET status = 2, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0
